correctness.rationale: All automorphisms preserve the characteristic commutator ideal and satisfy BA=aAB; finite nonzero real spectral scaling forces a=±1, with fixed-point freedom forcing a=-1. The real Jordan decomposition explicitly constructs B squaring to -I precisely when each imaginary Jordan size occurs with even multiplicity; primitive nilpotent Jordan quotients and determinant parity show any finite-order f.p.f. B needs that condition. Exact SymPy tests of 19 examples plus symbolic obstruction provide reproducible finite checks, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A structural and sharp field-dependent classification of fixed-point-free automorphisms for every centerless real almost-abelian Lie algebra. It resolves both unrestricted and periodic existence by an explicit all-Jordan invariant and separates infinite-only and order-four cases, including nonsemisimple families and a dimension-minimal obstruction.
